tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Primary brand color: logo top half, primary buttons and key accents. Large or bold text and fills only on light grounds (4.47:1 on #f6f6f6). For small text use text-blue.

tokens.name: text-blue
tokens.usage: Blue text and links that must pass 4.5:1 on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Secondary blue for hover states, and depth on blue backgrounds.

tokens.name: brand-gradient-start
tokens.usage: Start of the blue gradient for hero and feature blocks. Use white text on it (8.45:1).

tokens.name: brand-gradient-end
tokens.usage: End of the blue gradient for hero and feature blocks.

tokens.name: iron-grey
tokens.usage: Logo lower half and "Fix" wordmark. Decorative only, never for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and dark sections (17.05:1 on surface-100).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and labels (5.36:1 on surface-100).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard padding and side gutter (also the minimum page gutter on phones).
